summary: This round goes well beyond the staging label: it adds a footer account button with an Account modal and sign-out. Sign-out works through ElectronHost and the desktop IPC (ControlPlaneAuth revokes the bearer session and removes the saved token; local identities are hidden), through WebHost (Better Auth signOut), and through Authentication, which returns to the signed-out screen. The main-process logic is sound and well tested by signOut.test.ts and the control-plane bearer test. It is not ready: the new account E2E fails, 11 changed lines are uncovered with no exemptions, and the sign-out failure path in the UI is untested.

findings.body: The temp Playwright run fails. After signing back in at 390 px, the test opens the drawer with `app.page.mouse.click(26, 20)`, then waits for `getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Workspace navigation' }).getByTestId('account-button')`, which is never found (line 74). The error-context snapshot shows the signed-in workspace with a visible "Open sidebar" button, so the coordinate click missed it or ran before the header was rendered. Click `app.page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open sidebar' })`, which auto-waits, instead of raw coordinates. Then confirm that the drawer shows the account button after re-sign-in. If it still does not, that is a product defect that needs investigation.

The sign-out failure path is untested. When `host.signOut()` returns an Error (for example ControlPlaneAuth cannot remove the saved session, or Better Auth returns an error on the web), Authentication.signOut (Authentication.tsx:92) must keep the user signed in, and AccountButton must show the message in the `role="alert"` block and re-enable the Sign out and Close buttons. No test checks this; the E2E covers only the success path. Add a temp test, such as a renderer test with a fake HostApi whose signOut returns an Error. It should assert that the alert text is shown, the account button stays mounted, and the sign-in page does not appear.

testRequests.target: apps/web-app/src/WebHost.ts:31 and 140-146 (getAppInfo().deployment; signOut success, rejected promise, and result.error)
testRequests.rationale: No test loads WebHost. Mock `better-auth/client` createAuthClient. Check that signOut returns undefined on success, returns a WebHostError when the call rejects and when `result.error` is non-null, and that getAppInfo reports `window.location.host` as deployment.

The changed reauthenticate branch is uncovered. Use a fake host whose signIn returns a session after a reauthentication request. Assert that useAccount() then exposes that session (user email/name) and useAuthenticatedUserId() returns its user id.

Uncovered, with no exemption. Either add a unit test that mocks `electron`'s contextBridge/ipcRenderer and checks that `signOut` invokes DESKTOP_CHANNEL with `{ type: "signOut" }`, or mark the lines coverage-exempt with a reason (preload runs only inside Electron, and the passing E2E exercises it).
